title: Migration completion is not Gen2 operational readiness
summary: After Gen1 migration, verify the exact separately approved first refresh, actual destination data/freshness, incremental settings and downstream consumers. Unknown or unchecked evidence cannot pass; never refresh, grant, take over, switch modes or replay automatically.
must: Use context workflow gen1-upgrade-readiness with original receipt, endpoint and explicit scoped identities. Match migration result scope/counts; partial/unknown is not success.
First refresh requires separate approval. Observe the exact retained job, not latest history; no refresh receipt means not_checked, not permission to submit.

Compare actual destinations/mappings/incremental settings against the pre-upgrade baseline. Query actual destination tables read-only for expected rows/batch keys and approved freshness high-watermarks; completed refresh and preserved IDs do not prove data arrived correctly.

Verify each consumer's exact refresh, binding, schema/queryability and expected visual/business behavior under intended reader identities. Metadata visibility does not prove grants for other users. Never alter credentials, roles, storage/security modes, definitions or consumers to make checks pass.

Keep results private and scoped. Report unknown/not_checked/blocked honestly and fail the acceptance gate unless every applicable required check is ready. Missing baseline or unavailable fixture is a blocker, not inferred equivalence.
